decisions.reason: The main-board solution is referenced only as an existing analogy; the source requests applying it to the sensor board and does not change the main-board layout.
The source concerns repositioning bottom items on the sensor board and does not mention or alter the power-board layout.
Repositioning sensor-board items changes mechanical arrangement, not the required connector inventory, types, pinouts, or count.
The mechanical relocation does not change sensor logic levels, level-shifter requirements, reserved footprints, or future adapter-board policy.
Moving and reorienting board items does not change the requirement to hardwire SPS30 SEL to ground for I2C mode.
The source changes sensor-board placement only and does not add, remove, consolidate, or redefine any main-board connector.
The sensor-board mechanical rearrangement does not alter monitored rails, monitor placement, current coverage, or the monitoring IC.
The source does not change boost-enable control, GPIO assignment, powered loads, or switched-5V behavior.
The requested sensor-board item movement has no entailed effect on ESP32 GPIO assignments.
The source does not change LED supply voltage, data-level handling, level shifting, model, or power-control separation.
Mechanical repositioning within the sensor board does not alter the board-chain order, rail forwarding, or power-distribution connectors.
The source does not affect standalone USB activation, LDO selection or capacity, powered scope, or sensor-debugging support.
